items.title: Among You
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who’s real? Who’s fake? Who knows? Suit up and choose from 8 colorful skins to role-play a real mystery. Can you catch the impostors in time, before they get you? Stay invisible on the spaceship, and try to get away with it. They can’t catch you if they can’t see you! Are they among us?

1 free skin included!

items.title: Pastel Demons
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Maybe you will be a little bad, but you will look so lovely! Show off your mischievous side, geared up in the softest colors: pink, yellow, and green. Choose from 12 pretty pastel skins to role-play as just a harmless demon…or not.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Pet Detectives
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Sherlock sheep or Poirot panda? Follow the leads, talk to witnesses, and investigate what happened. With 12 different animal skins, role-play as a famous detective and solve the mystery! 

1 free skin included!

items.title: Bunny Teens HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Hippity hoppity! Dress up in a cute and colorful bunny themed outfit to farm those carrots! Great skin pack for roleplay and basic survival. Comes with onesies, hoodies, and hats that mimic the bunny ear look. 

+ 18 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Diamond Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
They come from the sky or underground, there's no base safe from these glitches! Made from diamond and hiding among us in our mines and caverns, they've come for revenge against players! Ready your luck potions and your shields to block them!

- Includes 10 diamond glitch skins!

items.title: Ender Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
All throughout the sky blocky rifts are appearing and the glitches return from the End! These dark horrors are among us and you have to be skilled or lucky to survive!

- Includes 10 End themed glitch skins!

items.title: Animal Gamers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
It's time to play! Take your cute but badass animal gamer to another level, and show to your friends who is the boss!

- 30 unique HD animal gamers skins
+ 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion and Lostduckies

items.title: Mob Hoodies
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Weather is cold! Wear the new Mob Hoodies and start the adventure now!

- 10 unique Mob Hoodie skins
- Perfect for role-playing
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Magic Gems
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a magical gem! Be a magical, onyx, pearl, ruby, sapphire, or topaz!

+ 10 magical gem skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Parkour Teams
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Choose a side, cyan, lime, pink, purple, or red! Then compete in parkour! Perfect for your next parkour match.

+ 20 parkour skins!
+ 4 sides to choose from!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Trendy Fashionistas
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Trendy waves arrived in the city! Start by choosing the trendiest Minecraft skins. Whether you're a demon, stylish teen, high school student, or a masked teen, we have it all! Discover modern skins and become the ruler of this free world. Let your next adventure begin!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Teen Demons 2
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Those horns though.
9 skins | Created by Tetrascape

items.title: Classic Furniture
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Decorate your home with over 4000 survival-compatible furniture options and modify your kitchen, bedroom, living room, bathroom & outdoor garden! Try new furniture, use custom tools to decorate houses in the city and drive many cars. 

- 75+ unique models featuring up to 12 color variants
- 400+ furniture textures
- Includes large city with luxury houses
By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Advanced Anime
items.creator: Atheris Games
items.description:
Ever want to immerse yourself into the crazy world of anime? With bright and vibrant colors, as well as stunning new twists on characters and Minecraft mobs, your game will feel like you've jumped into your favorite anime series. No matter your tastes, we think you'll find something unique in this pack.

+ 10 anime skins
+ 1.17 resource pack
+ By Atheris Games

items.title: Rockett Adventures 7
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Get lost in this skyblock adventure! Jake and Nora are trapped in a book that's tearing itself apart. Pages are morphing into floating islands, and hint at a peculiar lost city in the Nether. Can they escape?
- Nether and overworld skyblocks
- 2 skins
- 3 separate stories
- 4 boss fights
- A fully-voiced adventure
- Custom music
- Single-player

Skyblock City!

items.title: Zombie Base Hotel
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Zombie hordes are upon you! You've found a hotel that can be used as a base! It's time to survive!

- Huge hotel perfect for surviving the apocalypse!
- Walled perimeter with watchtowers!
- Farm! Stables! Crafting area! 
- Many rooms to choose from!
- Lobby perfect for hanging out with your friends!
- The perfect base! 
- Plenty of room to customize the area!

items.title: Mythe Edhil
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Discover the hidden jewel of Mythe Edhil: an elven relic of an era long gone. 

- Visit the bustling villages and meet the locals! 
- Become your own monarch of an ancient castle, a studious wizard of the arcane tower, or captain of your own pirate ship.
- Uncover ancient treasures that lie beneath if you're brave enough...

items.title: Anime Fantasy Warriors
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
An entire skin pack filled with YOUR favourite Anime characters!
Fabulous hair, beautiful outfits, and endless roleplay possibilities for everyone! This pack is all you need for the perfect time together with your friends.

- 10 cute & adorable skins!
- 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Golden

items.description:
Need to show your friends who’s boss?? Then these luxurious outfits are a perfect fit for you!

8 EXCLUSIVE HD Skins!

items.title: Gaming Teens

items.description:
Are you a true gamer? With these 10 teen skins you can show everyone your skills!

items.title: One Chunk Survival
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for a new challenge? There are only 5 chunks in this world! Think carefully about how you use your resources and equip yourself for the fight against the ender dragon.

+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FallStudios

items.title: Warlords
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
There is an art in warfare. The warriors and skills sharpened through the test of battle become the stuff of legends! Will you become legend?
- 12 roleplay skins!
- Warrior attire inspired by cultural history!
